description: Matt-first, GitHub-native outcome coordination for coding agents, with direct work left direct.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive GitHub coordination for durable coding outcomes.
interface.longDescription: Project Truss coordinates Matt-first engineering directly. Setup configures a repository once; Start begins or resumes work, invokes the relevant Matt disciplines, routes the GitHub-native stages, and continues to truthful closeout.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-truss:start to begin or resume Matt-first work; use $project-truss:setup once per repository and call another Project Truss stage when you intentionally enter it.
